recovery_design: An outbox requeue receipt authorizes failed-only Workflow reuse. A distinct recovery input path reconstructs state through a scoped Domain Activity, expires only the current elapsed lease with audit, and never allocates Attempts. It drains historical notifications against authoritative facts, remains available for explicit retry, and completes terminal Runs only after their outbox drains. Existing workflow histories and automatic-attempt policy are unchanged.
